get.summary: Get the list of supported API versions

Get the list of networks
get.description: The method returns the list of networks by the specified filters. You can use top-level network attributes as filters, for example, ``name``. The "AND" condition is applied to the specified filters.

post.description: The method creates a cloud network. The method supports creating multiple networks at once. To do this, specify the list of networks in the request body using the ``networks`` array.

get.summary: Get information about a network
Get the list of ports
get.description: The method returns the list of ports by the specified filters. You can use top-level port attributes as filters, for example, ``name``. The "AND" condition is applied to the specified filters.

post.description: The method creates a port in the specified network. The method supports creating multiple ports at once. To do this, specify the list of ports in the request body using the ``ports`` array.

put.description: The method adds an interface to a standard router. If the request body contains a subnet ID, a port will be created to connect the subnet to the router.
The method deletes a standard router interface and disconnects it from the subnet. The interface port associated only with this subnet will be deleted.

get.summary: Get the list of subnets

ecmp_enabled.description:
The parameter determines whether the ECMP option is enabled. If enabled, the router will create several routes to a single destination. During data transfer, if one of the routes is unavailable, another one will be selected automatically. This increases throughput and fault tolerance.

Possible values:

``true`` — option enabled,

``false`` — option disabled

enabled.description:
The parameter determines whether the BGP router is enabled.

Possible values:

``true`` — enabled,

``false`` — disabled

graceful_restart.description:
The parameter determines whether the Graceful restart option is enabled. If enabled, after a node restart the BGP router will keep its state and continue to transfer data.

Possible values:

``true`` — option enabled,

``false`` — option disabled

long_lived_graceful_restart.description:
The parameter determines whether the Long lived graceful restart option is enabled. If enabled, the BGP router will keep its state for a longer time in case of a BGP node failure.

Possible values:

``true`` — option enabled,

``false`` — option disabled

force_ibgp_next_hop_self.description:
The parameter determines whether the Next Hop Self option is enabled. If enabled, the BGP neighbor receives the IP address of the interface of the router that sends the announcement as the intermediate node (Next Hop).

Possible values:

``true`` — option enabled,

``false`` — option disabled

bfd_enabled.description:
The parameter determines whether the BFD option is enabled. This allows using session control via BFD (Bidirectional Forwarding Detection).

Possible values:

``true`` — option enabled,

``false`` — option disabled

priority.description: Interface priority during VRRP election. A router becomes Master if it has the highest priority. VRRP priority is set to values from 1 to 254. The value 0 is reserved for cases when the Master needs to give up responsibility for routing. The value 255 is set for the router that owns the virtual IP address

preempt.description: Flag for immediate switchover if a participant with a higher priority is present

master.description: Router role in this VRRP group. VRRP Master is the router that forwards packets for the given virtual group. VRRP Backup is the router that waits for a packet from the Master. If packets from the Master stop arriving, the Backup tries to switch to the Master state

action.description:
The parameter determines the behavior of the VK Cloud platform if the remote peer is unavailable.

Possible values:

``hold`` — when unavailability is detected, the IPsec connection is terminated. The connection can be re-established only by the remote peer.

``clear`` — when unavailability is detected, the IPsec connection is terminated. The connection will not be re-established, even if the remote peer tries to do so.

``restart`` — when unavailability is detected, the IPsec connection is terminated. The VK Cloud platform will try to re-establish the connection with the remote peer

interval.description: Interval (in seconds) at which DPD probe messages are sent

timeout.description: Time for detecting peer unavailability in seconds. If no DPD probe message has been received from the remote peer by the end of this time, the peer is considered unavailable (dead)
